title: 5 high paying tech jobs that don't require coding

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What high-paying tech jobs might thrive in a world where coding isn't the only path to innovation?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Roles like AI ethics officers and data privacy architects are rising, using tools like generative AI and blockchain for security.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But without coding skills, how can we ensure these professionals understand the risks and biases embedded in the systems they manage?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are creating no-code platforms and AI-assisted tools that let non-coders validate models and trace data lineage.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where ethics and tech are co-designed, with diverse voices shaping AI’s impact on society.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of tech will be shaped not just by coders, but by those who align innovation with human values.

video_cue: A diverse team of professionals collaborating in a modern office, using AI tools to design ethical technology solutions.
